caption: Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no lyrics, no drums. Ambient underwater soundscape music, very minimal and textural, in the style of Brian Eno, Stars of the Lid and Jon Hopkins ambient works. Slow evolving pads and drones, long reverb tails, no clear melody, no rhythm, no percussion, nothing dramatic or orchestral. Bright and weightless sunlit shallow sea: warm airy synth pads in E major, soft shimmering granular textures like light dancing on the water, distant glassy chimes, gentle swelling layers. Peaceful, meditative, spacious. Loop-friendly, no ending.

Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no lyrics, no drums. Ambient underwater soundscape music, very minimal and textural, in the style of Brian Eno, Stars of the Lid and Jon Hopkins ambient works. Slow evolving pads and drones, long reverb tails, no clear melody, no rhythm, no percussion, Subtle unease: low pulsing sub-bass drone in C minor, slow dissonant string-like pads, faint metallic scrapes, a heartbeat-like very soft low throb, gradually thickening tension without any climax. Dark, ambient, understated.

Slow evolving pads and drones, long reverb tails, no clear melody, no rhythm, no percussion, nothing dramatic or orchestral. Awe and wonder as a giant whale passes: slowly blooming warm pads in D major, deep soft sub-bass, distant wordless airy choir-like texture (no words), gentle rising shimmer. Tender, vast, breathtaking but calm. Long fade.

Lonely, mysterious, calm. Loop-friendly.

Fades to silence.
